title: Echo draft generator (h key): write post draft via echo.fulcrum.inc
description: Hidden key h opens prompt TextArea; sends 3 latest + 2 largest published posts as <post> samples plus the prompt to Echo; spinner while waiting (up to 5+ min); result saved as new draft .md

title: Revisit dependency upgrades blocked by optimum-onnx pin
description: transformers 4.57.6, sentence-transformers 5.7.0, huggingface-hub 0.36.2, tokenizers 0.22.2 and optimum 2.1.0 are held back (latest: 5.19.0, 6.1.0, 2.1.1, 0.23.2, 2.3.0). Cause: optimum-onnx 0.1.0 (latest) requires optimum~=2.1.0 and transformers<4.58; src/hugin/embeddings.py:176 uses SentenceTransformer(backend='onnx'), which needs it. Options: (1) wait for an optimum-onnx release supporting transformers 5 [safe]; (2) switch to backend='torch' and drop optimum/optimum-onnx/onnx, measuring load time, speed and memory first; (3) run onnxruntime directly (rewrite, not worth it). Also: uv.lock is stale because secrets-resolver is a local package (../jano) with no [tool.uv.sources]; uv sync/lock fail. Rebuild venv with: uv venv --clear && uv pip install -e ../jano -e '.[dev]' --upgrade. Test any upgrade in a separate venv first.
